cohort: The study included 102 pregnant women aged 18-40 years undergoing elective or emergency cesarean sections under subarachnoid block, classified as ASA 2.
finding: Both norepinephrine and phenylephrine effectively counteracted hypotension during spinal anesthesia, but norepinephrine was associated with a significantly lower incidence of bradycardia compared to phenylephrine.
mod_finding: The findings are specific to women undergoing spinal anesthesia for cesarean section, demonstrating the efficacy of both drugs in this context.
